import re

_FACTORS = {'B': 1, 'KB': 1024, 'MB': 1024 ** 2}


def to_bytes(text: str) -> int:
    match = re.fullmatch(r'(\d+)(B|KB|MB)', text)
    if match is None:
        raise ValueError(f'invalid size: {text!r}')
    return int(match.group(1)) * _FACTORS[match.group(2)]
E
